standards.title: Pipe Slope Requirements
standards.rule: Drain pipes must slope at minimum 1/4 inch per foot (2% grade) for pipes under 3 inches diameter
standards.violation_indicator: Insufficient slope, standing water, slow drainage
standards.reference: IPC 704.1 / Pakistan Building Code Section P-2603

standards.title: Vent Pipe Installation
standards.rule: Every fixture trap must be vented within 6 feet of the trap weir to prevent siphonage
standards.violation_indicator: Gurgling drains, sewer gas smell, slow drainage

standards.title: Water Hammer Prevention
standards.rule: Install water hammer arrestors on quick-closing valve supply lines (washing machine, dishwasher)
standards.violation_indicator: Loud banging noise when water stops, pipe vibration

standards.title: Hot Water Temperature
standards.rule: Water heater thermostat should be set to 120F (49C) to prevent scalding while killing bacteria
standards.violation_indicator: Water too hot at tap, scalding risk

standards.title: Backflow Prevention
standards.rule: Install backflow preventer on irrigation systems, boiler feed lines, and hose bibs

safety.requirement: Safety glasses required when cutting pipe, soldering, or working with pressurized lines
safety.mitigates: Eye injury from debris, chemical splash, UV from soldering

safety.requirement: Cut-resistant gloves for pipe cutting, heat-resistant gloves for soldering
Gas monitor, ventilation fan, and standby person required for manhole/crawlspace entry

safety.rule: Use lead-free solder and fittings. Test older pipes for lead content before work.
safety.mitigates: Lead poisoning, contamination of drinking water

tools.name: Pipe Wrench
tools.use: Turning and holding pipes and fittings

tools.name: Pipe Cutter
tools.use: Clean cutting of copper, PVC, and PEX pipes

tools.name: Plunger
tools.use: Clearing clogs in drains and toilets

tools.name: Basin Wrench
tools.use: Tightening/loosening faucet nuts in tight spaces

common_violations.issue: No Teflon tape on threaded joints
No shutoff valve on fixture supply

common_violations.consequence: Pipe sag, stress on joints, eventual failure

common_violations.issue: Mixing galvanized and copper without dielectric union
No primer used before PVC cement
